name: 5-PPDI
summary: An obscure analogue of α-PBP, which is itself an analogue of α-PVP. This rare compound has little history of human usage. There are some trip reports that suggest it is inactive. In the case that it is active, it likely has a similar effect profile to other pyrovalerone stimulants.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.en: Little has been published about it. Pyrovalerone-type stimulants block the reuptake of dopamine and noradrenaline, and it may work the same way if it is active at all.
pharmacology.zh: 相關研究很少。吡咯戊酮型的興奮劑會阻斷多巴胺與正腎上腺素的回收；若它確實有活性，可能也以同樣方式作用。
pharmacology.zhHans: 相关研究很少。吡咯戊酮型的兴奋剂会阻断多巴胺与正肾上腺素的回收；若它确实有活性，可能也以同样方式作用。

uses.en: It has been sold as a designer stimulant. There is almost no history of human use.
uses.zh: 它曾作為設計師興奮劑販售，幾乎沒有人體使用紀錄。
uses.zhHans: 它曾作为设计师兴奋剂贩售，几乎没有人体使用纪录。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its family, the α-pyrrolidinophenones such as α-PVP, can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, overheating, insomnia, agitation, paranoia and a strong urge to keep redosing. Serious risks include psychosis, violent agitation, heart problems, seizures and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同家族的α-吡咯烷苯酮類藥物（例如α-PVP），可能引起心跳急促、血壓升高、體溫過高、失眠、躁動、多疑，以及想一再追加用藥的強烈衝動。嚴重風險包括精神病、激烈躁動、心臟問題、癲癇發作與成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同家族的α-吡咯烷苯酮类药物（例如α-PVP），可能引起心跳急促、血压升高、体温过高、失眠、躁动、多疑，以及想一再追加用药的强烈冲动。严重风险包括精神病、激烈躁动、心脏问题、癫痫发作与成瘾。

fact.en: Its name follows the pyrrolidinophenone pattern, where each letter stands for part of the structure. Some trip reports suggest it may be inactive, which happens when a small change stops a drug binding at all.
fact.zh: 它的命名沿用吡咯烷苯酮的規則，每個字母代表結構的一部分。一些使用報告認為它可能沒有活性；當一個小改變讓藥物完全無法結合受體時，就會發生這種情形。
fact.zhHans: 它的命名沿用吡咯烷苯酮的规则，每个字母代表结构的一部分。一些使用报告认为它可能没有活性；当一个小改变让药物完全无法结合受体时，就会发生这种情形。
